name: pepper
description: Pepper — production media generation API (image, video, audio, text) over stable-diffusion.cpp, llama.cpp and audio.cpp.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pepper/core && npm run build --workspace @pepper/web && npm run build --workspace @pepper/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pepper/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @pepper/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @pepper/web
